incompatibleRuntime.title: Este sistema no es compatible con el backend incluido
incompatibleRuntime.description: evaOS Workbench opened, but the local managed runtime backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart evaOS Workbench.

incompleteInstallation.title: evaOS Workbench installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so managed runtime cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest evaOS Workbench. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined managed runtime.
incompleteInstallation.diagnosticsReportFailed: Error al enviar el reporte de diagnóstico
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: Esta instalación no tiene los componentes de runtime necesarios, por lo que {{resource}} no puede iniciar. Reinstala el último paquete de evaOS Workbench. Si sigue fallando, verifica si el software de seguridad o antivirus puso en cuarentena componentes de evaOS Workbench.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: evaOS Workbench package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This evaOS Workbench package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: evaOS Workbench opened, but local backend stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling evaOS Workbench may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: evaOS Workbench opened, but local backend stopped while repairing local agent cache data. Reinstalling evaOS Workbench may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: evaOS Workbench detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. With your confirmation, evaOS Workbench will ask the managed runtime to back up the old database and create a new local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.cancelHint: No database changes were made. Restart evaOS Workbench when you are ready to try recovery.
